mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.15% and rises for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.15% and rising.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in retail sales (RSAFS) indicate deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and RSAFS falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 750,000 units signal robust consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST > 750,000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate relative to its 6-month moving average indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises relative to its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% and rises for three consecutive months, it signals severe labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and rising.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and declines in industrial production (INDPRO) indicate monetary tightening coinciding with manufacturing weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.
